name: UCI-HAR → PAMAP2
description: Train on UCI-HAR (6 activities, waist smartphone, 9 channels, 30 subjects) and evaluate on PAMAP2 (12 activities, 3 body-worn IMUs, 27 channels, 8 subjects). Only the 6 shared activity classes are evaluated: Walking, Walking Upstairs, Walking Downstairs, Sitting, Standing, and Lying (mapped from PAMAP2 Lying). This pair tests generalization from a single sensor to multiple sensors, and from a small source domain to a larger target domain.

protocol.type: Train on source, test on target
protocol.note: PAMAP2 has 3 IMU positions; pick one (chest recommended) or use all three. Report mean ± std across 8 LOSO folds.
